apps.localizedDescription:
Apps2Samsung installs Jellyfin and other web and community apps onto your Samsung Tizen TV — no PC, no Tizen Studio, and no manual sideloading.

This is the mobile (phone) installer head of Apps2Samsung. Put your TV into Developer Mode, point the app at it over your local network, sign in once with a free Samsung account to provision a signing certificate, and install.

Features:

* Finds Samsung Tizen TVs on your network, or connect directly by IP.
* Installs Jellyfin (multiple build variants) and a catalog of community apps.
* Give any app a custom launcher icon and a custom title.
* Optional Jellyfin server pre-configuration: server URL, auto-login, and custom CSS.
* Uses a free Samsung account certificate — no paid developer account required.

Requirements:

* A Samsung Tizen TV in Developer Mode, on the same local network as your phone.

Desktop versions for Windows, macOS and Linux are also available. Apps2Samsung is free and open source (MIT).

## 📦 v3.2.0-beta: 2026-11-05


### 🚀 New features
- Certificate sheet: copy the sign-in link for another browser (#912)
- Catalog: carry the Tizen version each package asks for (#926)
- Arm TV-Store with every signing profile this device holds (#927)
- Heads: "Needs Tizen X" like TV-Store, from the catalog's required_version (#933)
- Android: scan the phone's own hotspot and show the hotspot IP as this device (#920) (#930)
- Export / import the signing certificate on its own, on every head (#921) (#932)
- Add: type into apps that draw their own keyboard (YouTube) with the d-pad (#834)
- Add: live typing from the laptop keyboard (stacks on #834) (#917)
- Community catalog: cert_level per package, so a Partner-only app is signed Partner (TV-Store #50) (#953)
- Dial TV-Store's relay when the TV's Host PC IP is 127.0.0.1 (TV-Store#52) (#955)
- feat(catalog): add your own sources (repository, release or .wgt/.tpk link) on every head (#969)
- feat(tv-card): say what the guide knows, show the route, offer the fix (all heads) (#971)
- CLI: linux-bionic-arm64 build for Termux on Android (#976)
- CLI: sign a package without installing it (#980)
- Sign without installing and the TV-Store hand-off on the desktop and the phone (#979) (#983)
- CLI: install through TV-Store's upload page when SDB can't reach the TV (#981)
- CLI: the v3 look on a terminal (#975) (#987)
- CLI: the menu (#975) (#989)
- Tizen certificate: the SDK's own, no DUID and no Samsung account, as a second certificate type (Core + CLI, #988) (#990)
- Tizen certificate on both heads: Settings choice, two-step sheet, the TV's refusal (#988) (#992)
- CLI menu: one screen at a time (#975) (#995)
- Updates take the variant the TV got: remembered per TV on every head (#975) (#998)
- CLI: `leftovers`, the toolbox's Install leftovers card, and its menu screen (#975) (#999)
- Catalog snapshot: publish each package's icon with its SHA-256 for TV-Store (#1000) (#1001)
- Show the catalog's app icons on desktop and mobile (#1000) (#1002)
### 🐛 Bug fixes
- On the TV: View in catalog crash, search by developer, developer tap, TV-Store catalog button (#888), version 3.2.0 (#906)
- Install: a TV rejecting the certificate is not a certificate mismatch (#907) (#910)
- Certificate rejected [118, -12]: say the TV needs internet to verify it (#907) (#915)
- Arm TV-Store: find a TV-Store installed under a new package id (#839) (#923)
- Back to the package's own id: forget a remembered package-id rename (#839) (#924)
- Read [118, -11] "Author certificate not match" as the certificate mismatch (#928)
- Desktop: re-read this machine's IPs on every scan and after a network change (#922) (#931)
- Heads read [118, -19]; CLI catalog shows the Tizen each file asks for (#937)
- Localize the Public / Partner labels in Settings and the remaining hard-coded UI text (#938)
- Fix: review findings on the keyboard planner and live typing (#948)
- Debug launch: send `0 debug <id> 30` to Tizen below 4.0 (#954) (#957)
- Relay-aware Dev Mode guide, relay-dropped hint, TV-Store arm follow-up, Tizen 3 attach (#964)
- Show the relay's own reason for a dropped connection; drop the "not 127.0.0.1" advice (#967)
- Harden the relay work: guide restart check, Android addresses, inspectors without awaitPromise (#968)
- fix(l10n): TV information rows and Core install progress in the user's language (#972)
- CLI: ship linux-bionic-arm64 as a folder, the single-file build cannot start (#982)
- CLI: run the Termux build on Termux's own .NET runtime, the bionic runtime pack segfaults (#985)
- CLI menu: the terminal's real width, choices that fit it (#975) (#997)
- Catalog snapshot: read packages eight at a time, 45-minute job budget (#1000) (#1003)
- Updating TV-Store through its own relay: the dropped connection is the expected end, not a failed install (#1005) (#1006)
- Catalog icons: read a hybrid .wgt's icon from res/wgt/ too, with a one-off re-read switch (#1000) (#1008)
### 🌍 Translations
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#916)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#925)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#936)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#939)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#940)
- i18n: fill the missing translations of all 29 languages, unreviewed (#944)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#946)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#949)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#956)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#963)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#965)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#974)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#984)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#991)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#994)
### 🧰 Maintenance & CI
- Refactor: redesign the Apps2Samsung download page (#904)
- CI: version guard on PRs, pin appimagetool, document the required checks (#908)
- Update Ko-fi link for Patrick's support (#914)
- Notify winget-apps2samsung from the stable release (#918)
- Release workflows: one run at a time per branch (#929)
- Crowdin: full-sentence sources, weekly report, approve only reviewed languages (#942)
- Crowdin: the weekly approve run covers every language except Czech (#945)
- Revise iPhone app instructions and remove Arch Linux info (#947)
- Engine: TizenSdb.Core 1.1.9 (#959)
- CI: declare the read-only token scopes, stop persisting checkout credentials and lock the workflow actions (#977)
- CI: verify the workflow lockfile on every pull request (#978)
- CI: move the push token off the checkouts and run Plumber on every change (#986)
- README: match the Plumber score badge to the other badges (#993)
- README: shorter, plain-spoken, and up to date with v3.2 (#996)
- crowdin-sync: check out without persisting the token (code-scanning #12) (#1004)
